description: Manages the complete order lifecycle for medical device and commercial product ordering, including order creation, pricing, validation, submission, and fulfillment tracking with ERP integration.
setup_steps: Complete org readiness for order management
Configure order management settings in Admin Console
Set up product catalog with pricing and availability via PricebookEntry records
Configure order types and record types for different ordering scenarios (standard, rush, consignment)
Set up order templates for standardized ordering of common product combinations
Configure pricing rules and discount schedules
Set up inventory integration for stock validation (if required)
Configure order approval workflows based on value thresholds or product categories
Set up order submission and fulfillment tracking
Configure order-related Lightning components on account pages
Create metadata cache for order objects for mobile
Generate metadata cache
Configure mobile sync settings for offline ordering
prerequisites: Customer Engagement with Commercial Engagement edition installed
Inventory integration available (if stock validation required)
configuration_details: Order management encompasses the full order lifecycle from creation through fulfillment
Order types categorize different ordering scenarios (standard, rush, consignment, etc.)
Pricing rules integrate with platform price books and custom discount schedules
Order templates enable standardized ordering for common product combinations
Approval workflows route orders based on value thresholds or product categories
Inventory validation checks stock availability before order submission
Fulfillment tracking monitors order status through delivery
Integration with external ERP/fulfillment systems via middleware
Order repricing path: when pricing changes, existing draft orders may need recalculation
Order splitting supports partial fulfillment scenarios
objects_and_fields: Account (ordering account — ship-to vs bill-to distinction)
batch_jobs: Order repricing batch — recalculates pricing on existing draft orders when price changes occur
Inventory sync batch — synchronizes stock levels with external systems
gotchas: Source platform real-time pricing engine does not migrate — must configure pricing rules in target platform
Order approval workflows must be rebuilt in target platform
Backorder management differs between platforms
Credit check integration with ERP must be re-established
Order splitting (partial fulfillment) logic varies between platforms
Ship-to vs bill-to account distinction may differ — verify address model
Only migrate orders from last 2 fiscal years unless regulatory requirements dictate otherwise
mobile_considerations: Offline ordering requires complete metadata cache for order and product objects
Order creation and submission available offline with queue sync
Product catalog cached locally for offline product selection
Pricing calculations must work offline — cached price books used

description: Workflow-driven store/site visit execution for medical device and commercial teams. Supports configurable stages, geolocation verification, assortment checks, product image capture, AID scanning, and compliance auditing.
setup_steps: Configure Store Check workflows using the five-step framework: (1) outline workflow, (2) define objects/permissions, (3) identify condition fields, (4) plan actions per stage, (5) add validation rules/checklists
Define Store Check stages and transitions (e.g., Check-In > Inventory Audit > Shelf Review > Compliance Check > Check-Out)
Configure geolocation capture for check-in verification
Set up assortment check lists per store type or region
Configure product image capture settings
Set up AID scanning integration for automated product identification
Configure compliance audit checklists per store type
Enable visit record type routing for Store Check visits
Create metadata cache for Store Check objects for mobile
Generate metadata cache
prerequisites: Customer Engagement with Commercial Engagement edition installed
Visit Management configured with Store Check record type
Product catalog configured for retail/commercial products
Geolocation services enabled in the org
Camera/image capture permissions for mobile app
configuration_details: Store Check uses a workflow/stage model — each stage has defined actions, validations, and transitions
Geolocation capture at check-in verifies physical presence at the store location
Assortment checks validate that correct products are stocked at each location
Product image capture provides visual documentation of shelf placement and displays
AID scanning uses device camera to automatically identify products by barcode/image
Compliance audit checklists ensure regulatory and brand compliance at point of sale
Visit record type routing directs Store Check visits to the correct workflow
Store Check workflows leverage the platform five-step workflow preparation framework
permissions: Store Check execution permissions for field users
batch_jobs: Store Check compliance aggregation — summarizes compliance scores across locations
gotchas: Store Check workflows are highly customizable but must be designed carefully — use the five-step framework
Geolocation accuracy varies by device and environment — indoor locations may have lower accuracy
Image storage can consume significant file storage — plan capacity accordingly
AID scanning accuracy depends on product barcode/label quality
Different store types may require different workflows — use record type routing
Validation rules at each stage can prevent workflow progression if not carefully designed
mobile_considerations: Store Check is primarily a mobile use case — field execution on device
Offline support critical for in-store execution without reliable connectivity
Camera integration for product image capture and AID scanning
Geolocation capture at check-in — must have location permissions enabled
Large image files impact sync times — configure image compression settings
Checklist and stage progression available offline with sync on completion
